jobs.occupation: Software Engineer - C++, Multithreading (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
jobs.description:
As the leading company in the field of software solutions for healthcare, we operate in 19 countries and employ over 9,000 dedicated staff members. You will work in a dynamic and innovative environment full of opportunities. With your commitment and passion, you have the chance to make a sustainable difference.

CGM Leverages AI: We’re looking for people who feel the power of AI in the e-health environment, who want to help shape change, and who are driven by a curious passion to see how technology can make healthcare smarter, simpler, and better.

Together, we are shaping the healthcare system of the future. Become part of our mission and make a difference - for a world where knowledge saves lives!

Are you passionate about groundbreaking products? Do you have the talent to turn ideas into real, valuable solutions-while always keeping the bigger picture in mind? Then we’d love to meet you!

You design and develop high-end C++ components for our medical desktop applications, with a strong focus on performance, stability, and scalability.

You architect, implement, and review complex multithreading and parallelization concepts to ensure efficient, safe, and responsive execution in everyday clinical use.

You analyze, refactor, and optimize our large existing codebase (QT, CMake, Conan, MSVC, and embedded CEF), identify bottlenecks, and systematically raise the performance and quality of long-lived products.

You work closely with Architecture, QA, and Product Management, drive the modernization away from legacy MFC / ATL / Win32 and Delphi towards modern C++ and current .NET, and actively raise the overall C++ engineering bar.

You use AI agents and tools like Claude Code in your daily work to accelerate refactoring, code analysis, and legacy modernization, and you continuously improve our shared agents, skills, and workflows.

Several years of senior-level experience in professional C++ development, ideally in high-performance, highly parallelized desktop systems with significant ownership and end-to-end responsibility.

Excellent academic background with a completed university degree in computer science, mathematics, physics, electrical engineering, or a comparable technical discipline with very good grades.

Deep expertise in modern C++ (C++ 14/17/20), multithreading and concurrency, debugging and performance tuning, plus hands-on experience with Qt, CMake, Conan, MSVC, and integrating components such as CEF; confident, effective use of AI in software engineering, ideally including Claude Code or similar agentic coding tools as well as AI pipelines and context engineering.
Fluent German and fluent English, both in spoken communication and in writing, enabling you to work seamlessly in cross-functional, international teams and with German-speaking stakeholders.
A structured, analytical way of working, high-quality standards, strong problem-solving skills, innovation drive, proactive ownership and a pronounced sense of entrepreneurship with genuine enthusiasm for shaping the future of healthcare IT.

Mobile work: Work flexibly on the move two days a week and on site three days a week.

Attractive locations: In addition to fully equipped workplaces, regular events such as summer parties and Christmas parties await you at our locations.

Development: Our in-house academy and our portfolio of external cooperation partners will support you in your further development.

Health: Health is a valuable asset for us. Our in-house canteen offers a selection of tasty and healthy dishes every day, and we welcome you to our fully equipped fitness center for weekly courses (online & offline).

More is always possible: The kindergarten on our CGM campus in Koblenz helps our employees to organize their working day even more flexibly. We also offer corporate benefits, the option of a job bike, a company pension scheme, and much more.

details Be part of our success story. Apply by including your CV in

semiconductor, automotive, or highly regulated electronics

Basic programming/querying skills in SQL (Structured Query Language)

Participate in global projects and cross-functional collaboration.
International onboarding including approximately 9-12 months of
training in Taiwan. Additional contact details Please apply with your

equipment hookups, coordinating with equipment vendors, construction
teams, contract vendor management, and facility engineers to ensure

regulations. Technical Expertise: Review and approve hookup designs

water, ultra-pure water, Gas & Chemical, and other Plastic utility

Degree in Electrical, Chemical, Mechanical or Automation Engineering

processes and equipment. Language Skills: Fluent German and English
language skills. Professional Skills: Proficient with Microsoft
Office, discipline-specific software (i.e., AutoCAD, Revit, etc.).
Personal Attributes: Strong analytical thinking and highly effective
interpersonal and communication skills when interacting with others.
Location: Dresden, Germany. What we offer Each journey starts with a
first step. Joining ESMC at this early stage will provide you with the
unique opportunity to actively shape the future of the fab in Dresden,
boost your career and unlock your potential. Work in a fast paced,
international startup environment while at the same time having access
to the experience, talent, and resources of the largest and most
advanced semiconductor manufacturer in the world, TSMC. At ESMC, we
create an inclusive environment to inspire passion and enable the best
in YOU. It is the policy of ESMC to provide equal employment

Job announcement
The Institute of Anatomy at the Christian-Albrechts-University in Kiel, Germany, invites applications for
Research Assistant (PhD position in Renal Research)

to begin in January 2027, running for three years. The position is compensated equal to 65% E 13 TV-L.

The research group of Prof. Dr. Franziska Theilig (Cardiovascular and Renal research) is working on the development and progression of diabetic nephropathy and FSGS as well as the development of hypertension and edema formation as a consequence of kidney diseases.
As a part of our DFG-funded project regarding the impact of epigenetic modifications on preconditioning the diabetic nephropathy, we are seeking for an outstanding and highly motivated candidate for a Research Assistant position to support us. Your responsibilities:

Sample preparation for RNA-, ATAC-, RRB- or ChIP-sequencing and data analysis

Participation in animal experiments, physiological and morphological analyses of conditional knockout mouse models combined with in vitro experimental approaches

Your profile:

Candidates with a Master or Diploma in Bioinformatics, Biomedical Sciences, Biology, Biochemistry, Medicine, Cell or Molecular Biology or a closely related field

Bioinformatic experiences or strong interest in OMIC data evaluation

Programming skills
Basic understanding of mammalian cells, cell culturing, animal experiments and research
Fluency in written as well as spoken English

Good communication skills
Our support for you and our offer:

Support in developing your renal histopathological and high-resolution microscopy skills
Support in enhancing your experience in in vitro and in vivo analyses

Implementing your own ideas while working with an innovative team
Working in a state-of-the-art research facility with a collaborative network in Kiel, other labs in Germany and abroad
Working in a supportive, collegial environment

Kiel University sees itself as a modern and cosmopolitan employer. We welcome your application regardless of your age, gender, cultural or social background, religion, ideology, disability or personal identity. We promote gender equality.
The university is committed to increasing the percentage of female employees and therefore strongly encourages suitably qualified women to apply. Women are given preference in cases of equal aptitude, ability and professional performance.
The university is committed to the employment of severely disabled persons. Therefore, applications from severely disabled persons and persons of equal status will be given preferential consideration if they are suitable.
The campus and the city are characterized by a lively, innovative and international atmosphere. As a family friendly employer, we offer flexible working hours and very good conditions for balancing work and life commitments. In addition, we offer attractive continuing education and training opportunities, health management, a job ticket, and an attractive sports program at discounted rates.
Kiel is a beautiful city located at the Baltic Sea offering excellent opportunities for cultural and outdoor activities like sailing.

jobs.occupation: Scientific Project Coordinator (f/m/x) Environmental Data and AI Platform (DataMon) (IT-Projektkoordinator/in)
jobs.description:
© Kletr / Fotolia The Helmholtz Centre for Environmental Research
(UFZ) is a world-leading institution in environmental research and a
member of the Helmholtz Association, Germany’s largest scientific
organisation. With approximately 1,200 employees across Leipzig,
Halle, and Magdeburg, we have been conducting research since 1991
using a transdisciplinary approach to address the most pressing
challenges of our time: biodiversity loss, climate change, and
environmental pollution. Our goal is to translate excellent research
into practical solutions for policymakers, business, and society, and
to serve as a reliable partner in supporting transformation processes
toward a sustainable and just future for current and future
generations. We foster a culture of collaboration, openness, and
diversity within a work environment that actively promotes creativity
and personal development. Scientific Project Coordinator (f/m/x)
Environmental Data and AI Platform (DataMon) The job DataMon is a new
strategic UFZ initiative to build an integrated environmental data and
AI platform that brings together established monitoring products,
scientific data services and cross-domain analytical capabilities. The
platform will make UFZ data products more accessible, interoperable
and AI-ready, while creating new opportunities for integrated
environmental research and knowledge transfer. As Scientific Project
Coordinator, you will play a central role in turning this ambitious
interdisciplinary initiative into a coherent implementation process,
connecting scientific, technical and organisational perspectives
across UFZ and with external partners. Your tasks Establish and
maintain the integrated DataMon roadmap across the shared platform,
monitor and data-product modules, and cross-cutting AI and
spatial-computing services. Work closely with module leads to clarify
requirements, resolve dependencies and conflicts, prepare decisions,
agree on priorities and next steps, and ensure consistent follow-up
across the DataMon portfolio. Coordinate milestones, deliverables,
dependencies, resource requirements, risks and decisions across module
leads, research data management, IT, knowledge transfer, research
infrastructure units, technical working groups and external service
providers. Translate scientific and user needs into clear technical
and organisational requirements, identify reusable solutions and
synergies across modules, and align priorities, interfaces and
implementation pathways. Prepare and facilitate Steering Group
meetings, readiness reviews and cross-project workshops; draft
decision papers and ensure that agreed actions are followed up and,
where necessary, escalated. Establish and maintain project controls
for schedules, risks, changes, decisions, reporting and documentation,
and prepare concise status and management reports. Support the
procurement and commissioning of external development services,
coordinate service providers, and monitor deliverables, acceptance
criteria and knowledge transfer in close cooperation with the
responsible UFZ units. Coordinate the transition from project
implementation to sustainable operation, including responsibilities,
update cycles, quality assurance, maintenance requirements and user
support. We offer The freedom to master even the most demanding
challenges between basic research and practical application The chance
to work in interdisciplinary, international teams and benefit from a
variety of perspectives First class integration into national and
international research networks to work together on global challenges
Excellent research infrastructure and research data management to
optimally support your work Flexible working hours and a wide range of
options for balancing work and care responsibilities through our
family office Competent support and advice for international
colleagues arriving at the UFZ from the 'International Office' Special
annual payment, capital-forming benefits and subsidised Germany Job
Ticket A workplace in a vibrant region with a high life quality and
social and cultural diversity Your profile An academic degree at
master’s level or equivalent in environmental or natural sciences,
computer or data science, geoinformatics, engineering, science and
technology management, or a related field Several years of experience
managing complex, interdisciplinary digital, research-infrastructure,
software or data-platform projects, including multi-team roadmaps,
deliverables, dependencies, risks and reporting Proven ability to lead
through influence, create commitment across organisational boundaries,
address conflicts constructively, prepare and facilitate decisions,
and ensure consistent follow-up A strong technical understanding of
data platforms and software development, interfaces and APIs, data and
metadata workflows, FAIR principles, cloud or compute environments,
and AI-enabled services. Hands-on coding experience is welcome, but
not essential Excellent facilitation, presentation, negotiation and
writing skills, with the ability to communicate confidently with
researchers, IT specialists, management, stakeholders and external
service providers A structured, independent and outcome-oriented
working style, sound judgement in evolving and complex project
settings, and experience with agile or hybrid project management
approaches Very good written and spoken English and German Experience
with public procurement, contract deliverables or external service

Postdoctoral Researcher (m/f/d) – Institute for Pharmacology and Toxicology
Ref.-Nr.  601-2026
Third-party funding

The Faculty of Medicine is an integral part of the Otto-von-Guericke-University Magdeburg and cooperates with the Magdeburg University Hospital A.ö.R. in research, teaching and patient care.

Your Responsibilities:

We are seeking two highly motivated Postdoctoral Research Fellows to join our team investigating the molecular and cellular organization of the nervous system using cutting-edge spatial transcriptomics approaches. The successful candidates will work at the interface of neuroscience, genomics, and computational biology to map gene expression patterns across brain tissue with spatial resolution, contributing to our understanding of neural circuit organization, development, and disease.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a collaborative, well-resourced research environment with access to state-of-the-art spatial profiling platforms (e.g., MERFISH, 10x Visium), advanced microscopy, and high-performance computing infrastructure.

Two positions are available with complementary focus:

- Position 1 — Experimental/Wet-lab focus: Designing and executing spatial transcriptomics experiments on neural tissue, including tissue preparation, probe design, imaging, and data generation
- Position 2 — Computational/Analytical focus: Developing and applying computational pipelines for spatial transcriptomic data analysis, including cell-type mapping, spatial statistics, and integration with single-cell/single-nucleus datasets

(Candidates with strong interest and skills spanning both areas are also encouraged to apply and may be considered for either position.)

Key Responsibilities:

- Design, plan, and conduct spatial transcriptomics experiments on neural tissue samples
- Analyze and interpret complex spatial and single-cell genomic datasets
- Collaborate with neuroscientists, computational biologists, and clinicians within and outside the group
- Present findings at lab meetings, seminars, and international conferences
- Prepare manuscripts for peer-reviewed publication
- Contribute to grant writing and mentoring of graduate/undergraduate students
- Maintain rigorous documentation and adhere to good research and data management practices

Your Profile:

Essential Qualifications:

- A PhD (completed or close to completion) in Neuroscience, Molecular/Cell Biology, Genomics, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, or a related field
- Demonstrated research productivity (peer-reviewed publications and/or preprints)
- Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

For the experimental-focus position, in addition:

- Hands-on experience with molecular biology techniques (e.g., histology, immunohistochemistry, in situ hybridization, RNA-seq library prep)
- Experience with spatial transcriptomics platforms (e.g., Visium, MERFISH, Xenium, seqFISH) is highly desirable
- Experience with rodent or human brain tissue handling is a plus

For the computational-focus position, in addition:

- Strong programming skills (Python and/or R)
- Experience analyzing single-cell/single-nucleus RNA-seq or spatial transcriptomics data
- Familiarity with relevant packages/tools (e.g., Scanpy, Seurat, Squidpy, STUtility) and statistical/machine learning methods
- Experience with high-performance/cluster computing is a plus

We offer:

- Access to cutting-edge spatial transcriptomics and imaging technology
- A collaborative, interdisciplinary, and supportive research environment
- Funding and support to attend international conferences
- Opportunities for career development, mentoring, and grant-writing training
- Work and family in harmony: Through Klinikzwerge (https://kita.med.ovgu.de/) , childcare may be available, subject to availability
- Help protect the environment and enjoy discounted public transportation through a job ticket
- In addition, we offer a diverse range of sports and relaxation activities as part of our workplace health promotion program
- Onboarding: At the start of your employment, you will participate in our orientation program, where you will receive important information and training sessions

Terms and Conditions:

- **Salary: **The salary group E 13 according to “Tarifvertrag für den öffentlichen Dienst der Länder” awaits you
- **Appointment: **The position is to be filled as a full-time position, with a workload of 2,5 years, starting on 2027/01/01
